title: Simbu's 'Arasan' Promo Slips From Diwali to a Reported December 4 Theatre Release
excerpt: The eight-minute 'World of Arasan' promo is finished except for Anirudh Ravichander's new background score, reports say, and the plan now is to attach it to Vijay Sethupathi's 'Train' in early December — reaching some 1,000 Tamil Nadu theatres instead of 100.
body:
• The eight-minute promo for 'Arasan', Silambarasan TR's Tamil gangster film with director Vetrimaaran, has missed its planned Diwali release and may now reach theatres on December 4, reports say.
  • Editing and dubbing on 'The World of Arasan' promo are complete, according to reports citing Cinema Vikatan; what remains is Anirudh Ravichander's new background score, followed by censor certification.
  • The reported plan is to attach the promo to Vijay Sethupathi's 'Train' in the first week of December, which could put it in around 1,000 theatres across Tamil Nadu instead of the roughly 100 originally planned.
  • 'Arasan' is a Tamil-language spin-off set in the world of Vetrimaaran's 'Vada Chennai'; the film itself is slated for a theatrical release in 2027. An official announcement on the promo date is still awaited.

The promo that was supposed to be Diwali's big Tamil cinema moment will now, by current reports, arrive with a December release instead. The promotional video for Simbu's 'Arasan' has been postponed from its Diwali slot and may release in theatres on December 4, India Today reported. The reports are based on industry sources; the makers have not yet confirmed the new date.

Why the promo missed Diwali

The eight-minute promotional video, titled 'The World of Arasan,' was expected to offer a closer look at the film's characters, setting and connection to 'Vada Chennai.' According to Cinema Vikatan, as reported by 7Globe's summary of the Times of India report, the video was expected to feature Vetrimaaran's voice-over along with appearances by Silambarasan, Andrea Jeremiah, Priyanka Mohan and other cast members. Editing and dubbing are said to be complete, and the team initially planned to screen the promo in around 100 theatres.

What it still needs is music. The promo requires Anirudh Ravichander's background score before it can go for censor approval, and the composer is reported to be occupied with his wedding preparations. The team considered reusing the background score from the earlier 'Arasan' announcement video to avoid further delay; Vetrimaaran and Silambarasan are reported to have rejected that shortcut, preferring fresh music that matches the film's scale. Anirudh's score is his first collaboration with Vetrimaaran.

"The promotional video for Simbu's 'Arasan' has been postponed from its Diwali slot and may release in theatres on December 4, India Today reported."

The December plan

Producer Kalaipuli S. Thanu, Vetrimaaran and Silambarasan are reported to be discussing attaching 'The World of Arasan' to Vijay Sethupathi's 'Train,' expected in theatres in the first week of December — India Today puts the date at December 4. Under that plan the promo could reach around 1,000 theatres across Tamil Nadu, a far wider theatrical launch than the Diwali plan would have given it. The trade-off is time: fans wait several more weeks, but the promo lands on far more screens.

The film it is selling

'Arasan' is a Tamil-language action entertainer directed by Vetrimaaran and headlined by Silambarasan TR, known to fans as Simbu and STR. It is a spin-off from the world of Vetrimaaran's Dhanush-starrer 'Vada Chennai' — an untold story from that North Chennai gangster setting, not a direct sequel. The cast reported so far includes Andrea Jeremiah, Priyanka Mohan, Samuthirakani and Kishore. The film is slated for a theatrical release in 2027. For the diaspora audience, the promo's eventual release is expected simultaneously in theatres and on social media, a plan the producer has previously described in response to fan requests — so viewers outside India should not have to wait for a separate online drop.
